svg.title: FirstShift Route app icon, master
svg.desc: Vector master rebuilt 25 Nov 2026, traced to route-icon-512.png. Home-screen (maskable) version: the Route icon at 80% so the sails and the name stay inside the round safe zone, the band full width to the foot. Square, white ground, no transparency. Colours: navy #042D5E, blue #3574BA, band #FF4FB4, name #001829. Name in Barlow Condensed Bold 700 (SIL Open Font Licence); without that font installed, use the PNG.
